lines.text: David asks the LORD who may abide in His tent and dwell on His holy mountain.
The one who walks with integrity practices righteousness and speaks the truth from his heart.
He has no slander on his tongue, does no harm to his neighbor, and casts no scorn on his friend.
He despises the vile but honors those who serve Baal, and he does not revise a costly oath.
He lends his money without interest, refuses a bribe against the innocent, and will never go hungry.
